notes: Multi Studio version 2.3.4: **Extended Audio Format Support**: AI Transcriber now directly imports and transcribes AAC, Opus, and Windows Media Audio (WMA) files in addition to MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, and FLAC, allowing you to drag and drop voice notes and recordings from more devices without manual conversion., **Pristine Combined Audio Export**: Resolved an issue in Script Studio where exporting combined audio resulted in broken, distorted, or corrupted sound files. The audio engine now combines blocks with exact, sample-accurate silence gaps and lossless audio assembly for both WAV and MP3 formats., **Accidental Re-Render Protection**: Added a safety confirmation dialog to Script Studio when clicking "Render all" if audio blocks have already been generated, preventing accidental clicks from clearing your existing audio work., **Immediate Playlist Transcription**: Fixed an issue in AI Transcriber where clicking "Generate Playlist Transcript" immediately paused the queue and required clicking "Resume Queue". Batch playlist transcription now starts processing audio files right away., **Automatic Rate Limit Notice Dismissal**: Fixed an issue in AI Transcriber where the rate limit notification remained visible even after all audio files in the playlist were transcribed successfully. The notification now clears automatically as soon as files complete., **Reliable Cross-Drive File Renaming**: Fixed an issue in Batch Renamer where moving or renaming files across different drives, USB sticks, or external storage on your computer could fail with a system error. Renamer now seamlessly moves and renames files across any storage drive., **Watermark Crop Video Compatibility**: Fixed an issue in Watermark Remover where cropping videos with uneven pixel dimensions caused video processing to fail. The processor now automatically aligns video dimensions and applies standard color encoding so your exported videos play smoothly on all video players., **Automatic Audio Cache Cleanup**: Improved cache management in Script Studio to thoroughly clean up temporary audio files across all formats, keeping your computer's disk space tidy and clutter-free., **Reliable Uppercase Audio Recognition**: Fixed an issue in AI Transcriber where audio recordings saved with uppercase filenames (such as `.WAV` or `.MP3` from digital voice recorders) were occasionally misidentified.
